description: Tourism analytics discovered that attraction records in demodb lack a denormalized VisitCount field required by the new ranked-query API. HasVisited edges are the authoritative source of visit data. Use OrientDB Studio at http://localhost:2480/studio/index.html with server credentials root / GymAnything123! and connect to demodb. Add a VisitCount property to the Attractions class, compute each attraction's count from its incoming HasVisited edges, update every attraction record, and create an AttractionVisitAudit record for each attraction that has at least one visit.
